BiblicalUsage: The discerner appears once, in Hebrews 4:12: the word of God is "a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart." The word is critical in the old sense — it judges, sifts, and separates what is true in a person from what is not.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simply that this is why I cannot read Scripture casually: it reads me, and it tells the truth about what is in my heart whether I want to hear it or not.
